identity.visual_language: shadowed archives, surveillance eyes, cipher trails, ink-black water, stolen masks, library pages dissolving into smoke, blue psychic glints inside black corridors
identity.tone: quiet, conspiratorial, surgical, elegant, predatory, paranoid, controlled

pure mono-blue curiosity or public scholarship
pure mono-black brutality without information architecture

animation_layers.purpose: establish that the panel is being watched before it is acted upon
animation_layers.motion: a small blue-black eye glyph opens in the corner, scans the card/result panel, then collapses into a thin underline

animation_layers.purpose: represent encoded action carried by agents or combat lines
animation_layers.motion: thin glyph strings wrap around the selected item and travel along an invisible route before disappearing into a shadow mark

animation_layers.purpose: represent discard, mill, name removal, or library denial
animation_layers.motion: text fragments and card silhouettes desaturate, blur, and sink into dark water or an archive gap

animation_layers.purpose: represent Lazav-style copying, stolen identity, and adaptive cover
animation_layers.motion: a translucent mask crosses the portrait area, briefly reflecting another profile before locking into a new outline

animation_layers.purpose: represent slow advantage from surveil, mill, recursion, and stolen resources
animation_layers.motion: small archive cards drift from library to graveyard, then connect to payoff nodes with blue-black thread

animation_layers.purpose: finish with hidden agency rather than a loud victory beat
animation_layers.motion: the active glyph fades last, leaving a faint footstep/cursor trail that vanishes behind the panel edge
